seo.title: Wkil | AI assistant for customer replies, order confirmation and Facebook posts
seo.description: Wkil answers your customers on WhatsApp, Messenger, your site chat and Facebook comments, sends order confirmation messages, and writes your posts and publishes them to Facebook after you approve.
seo.openGraphTitle: Wkil | Tell it what to do. It gets the work done.
seo.openGraphDescription: An AI assistant for customer replies, order confirmation and Facebook posts. Try it without an account.

hero.title: Tell Wkil what you need, and it takes messages, comments, order confirmation and Facebook posts off your hands.
hero.subtitle: An AI assistant for business owners in Egypt. It answers your customers on its own, from what you've told it. When you ask it for something in the chat, nothing gets published, sent or changed until you approve.
hero.belowButtons: The free plan includes 100 conversations a month on Messenger and your site chat, with nothing to pay. WhatsApp and order confirmation are on paid plans.
hero.supporting: A moderator's work, in one place. Your number can stay on the WhatsApp Business app if you like, with Wkil replying alongside you.

capabilities.title: What Wkil takes off your hands

items.title: Messages and comments
items.intro: A customer asks, and Wkil answers from what you've told it. When it doesn't know, the conversation waits for you in the inbox.
points: On WhatsApp, Messenger and your site chat. Voice notes and images on WhatsApp and Messenger only.
Facebook comments: a short public reply, with the details on Messenger. You set this per page.
Following up with people who went quiet: off until you turn it on. Wkil goes back to the customer after the delay you set, and stops if anyone writes. On WhatsApp, only within the time Meta allows.
Customer memory: it saves from the conversation, and you choose what, like size and address.
items.tryIt: Try telling it: "Reply to Ahmed's comment and say the offer runs until Thursday." (After your approval)

items.title: Order confirmation
items.intro: Each new order from your store triggers a WhatsApp message to the customer with confirm and cancel buttons, so you know who confirmed and who canceled before you hand over to the courier.
points: See each order's status, and whether the message arrived. The result goes back to your store.
A daily limit for new customers on each number, and extra messages wait. Sending pauses if Meta raises a flag. This is protection, not a guarantee.
You'll need a store on EasyOrders or one that sends to a webhook, a connected WhatsApp number, and a Meta-approved template of the service type, not an ad.
items.tryIt: Try telling it: "Who canceled their order today?" (Read only)

items.title: Posts, from idea to your Facebook page
items.intro: Give it the goal, dates and number of posts, and it makes a plan saved as a draft. Publishing is Facebook only.
points: It writes the text for each post, and makes an image or edits one you have. Images use your credits.
It looks for ideas on websites or in posts you paste in.
It publishes or schedules to your page after you approve.
items.tryIt: Try telling it: "Make me a plan for 5 posts next week about the winter offer." (After your approval)

items.title: Teach it your business
items.intro: Wkil answers from what it knows about your business, so that's where you start.
points: Send your website link and it suggests a name, a way of talking and policies, if the site can be read.
Add your services, your customers' questions, and files for it to send, like a catalog or price list.
items.tryIt: Try telling it: "Read our website and prepare the business details." (Saved after your approval)

items.title: All your conversations in one place
items.intro: All four channels in one inbox. Reply yourself, and turn Wkil off in any conversation.
points: If someone works with you, invite them by email or link.
Reports: conversations, Wkil's replies, what waited for you and why, and average reply time, for the last 7 or 30 days.
items.tryIt: Try telling it: "How's business this week?" (Read only)

advanced.title: Advanced things most merchants don't need

items.label: Connect Wkil to your system
items.text: If your system has an API, define actions that look up a price or order status, or that book or cancel. They run only when a customer asks in chat, in the background, with an 8-second timeout. Lookups need you to add a required customer detail. You'll need someone technical.

items.label: Connect any store by webhook
items.text: If your store isn't on EasyOrders but can send orders to a webhook, connect it with a key and a signing secret.

where.title: Where it works
where.intro: It answers in 4 places and publishes in 1. There are no others.

items.name: WhatsApp
items.text: Replies, voice notes and images, and order confirmation messages. Your number can stay on the WhatsApp Business app, which suits a moderate number of orders, or you can use a dedicated number.

control.title: What it does on its own, and what waits for you

items.label: On its own
items.text: Wkil's replies to your customers, order confirmation messages, and follow-ups if you've turned them on. Wkil can get things wrong, so check its replies early on.

items.label: Waits for your approval
items.text: In the dashboard chat, it reads straight away. But a message to a customer, publishing a post, replying to a comment or changing a setting doesn't happen until you approve.

items.label: When it doesn't know
items.text: Wkil stops, and the conversation waits in the inbox until you open it, labeled sales, support, complaint or other. The customer waits until you reply.

items.label: When credits run out
items.text: The chat stops, Wkil stops replying, and conversations wait for you in the inbox.

notDo: It doesn't reply or publish on Instagram. Publishing is Facebook only.
It has no ready-made CRM integration.
It has no ready-made store connections other than EasyOrders.
Order confirmation works on orders that come from a connected store, not ones you take in messages.
It doesn't understand voice notes and images in comments or the site chat.
It's no guarantee your number won't be restricted. Meta's rules still apply to you.

chat.title: Ask it before you open an account
chat.limits: This is a demo that only answers about Wkil. It isn't connected to your business, doesn't publish or send anything to anyone, and it can get things wrong.
chat.initialMessage: Hi. Ask me what Wkil does, and what it doesn't.
prompts: A customer asked something Wkil doesn't know. What happens?
What do I need to confirm orders on WhatsApp?
Can it prepare this week's posts and publish them?
chat.errorText: Could not send your message. Try again.

pricing.title: Prices in EGP. Meta's WhatsApp fees are separate.
pricing.metaFees: WhatsApp fees aren't part of the plan price. You pay them to Meta directly, with no markup from Wkil: on order confirmation messages, and on WhatsApp replies after the first 1,000 messages a month per number. Without a payment method on Meta, messages after the first 1,000 won't be delivered. Messenger and site chat carry no Meta fees.
notes: All numbers are monthly. A conversation is one customer over 24 hours, however many messages they send.
Pay yearly and get 2 months free, with your price fixed for 12 months.
You don't pay on this site. Request a plan, and the Wkil team will contact you to turn it on and arrange payment.

accordions.question: Another WhatsApp number?
